# dep-pins

Check package.json overrides and patched versions against what is installed.

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--manifest` | path | no | `package.json` | Root package.json |
| `--modules` | path | no | `node_modules` | Installed packages folder |

Run it from the repo root:

```
caveman-blocks run dep-pins
```

It prints one JSON object with the keys ok, checked, problems.

Without the CLI, `python3 .blocks/dep-pins.py` runs the same file, but nothing is enforced: no effects gate, no path confinement, no output cap.
